unit.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for .NET targets net8.0 and net10.0 frameworks and is built using the dotnet CLI. The test suite resides in the tests/ directory and is executed with dotnet test Aspose.Slides.Foss.sln. Continuous integration runs on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS using workflows defined in .github/workflows/. The repository uses the Aspose.Slides.FOSS solution file for all build and test operations.
